hero.badge: The QR code that never becomes useless
hero.title: Print once. Change it forever.
hero.subtitle: With a regular QR code, if your link changes, the printed code is dead. QRHub lets you change its destination whenever you want, without ever reprinting — and shows you who scans, where and when.

showcase.label: one printed QR
showcase.caption: You change the destination. The printed QR stays the same.

problem.title: The real problem with regular QR codes
problem.subtitle: A free generator creates a frozen QR, forever. The day something changes, everything has to be redone.

dead.title: Frozen forever
dead.description: You print a QR pointing to your site or menu. You change address, card, offer? The QR now points to nothing.

blind.title: You're flying blind
blind.description: How many people scanned? From which city? Which device? With a free generator, you'll never know.

costly.title: Endless reprints
costly.description: Every change forces you to reprint flyers, menus, posters and stickers. Each time, it costs time and money.

solution.title: What QRHub changes for you

editable.title: Editable for life

measure.title: Every scan counted
